createdAt.description: When the task was created, in UTC.

type.patternErrorMessage: must be kebab-case: lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens
type.description: Id of the task's type, which builds, each time the task runs, what its run is given from the parameters, e.g. catch-up-thread to catch up on a thread.

params.description: The task's parameters, as its type expects them, e.g. the threadId of the thread to catch up on.

positionId.patternErrorMessage: must be kebab-case: lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens
positionId.description: Id of the position the task is for: whoever works the position does it.

parentTaskId.description: Id of the task it is a part of, in a tree of tasks. Absent for a task of its own.
parentTaskId.patternErrorMessage: must be kebab-case: lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens

causeEventId.patternErrorMessage: must be kebab-case: lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens
causeEventId.description: Id of the event the task was created for, i.e. the name of its file in .llmco/journal. The task's depth is that event's, plus one.

title: llmco task
description: A task for a position, in .llmco/tasks/<task-id>.json, the id being the time it was created followed by a random suffix. Never modified: the task's state comes from the journal's events.
